prompt:
A real photograph of the terrace in front of the colourful palace of Pena on its hilltop near Sintra, on a foggy April morning, in a tall vertical picture made of one single continuous view, caught as it happens, as a tourist would take it with a good phone camera. Taken with a 24 mm lens at standing eye height on the terrace, facing the palace, everything in sharp focus. Soft white fog light; the textures of real stone, fog, moss, ironwork, cotton, denim and skin.

The first reference picture shows the young man from the front, the second shows him from his side: his face, his wavy dark-brown hair, his short stubble, his build, his height and his clothes, the royal-blue hooded sweatshirt with its red band across the chest, the white t-shirt, the cream scarf with small blue embroidered flowers, the dark-blue jeans and the white canvas sneakers, stay exactly as in them.

Every surface in the picture is plain: the fog is plain white, the umbrellas are plain colours, the tourist's camera is plain black, and the clothes are plain cloth. Each object stands clearly on its own, with a band of bare paving around it, so that the eye can tell at once where everything is.

The picture is built in three bands, from the bottom edge to the top edge.

THE FOREGROUND, along the bottom of the picture:
- the young man of the reference pictures stands in the middle, seen whole from his head to his white sneakers, facing the camera; he poses with his arms spread wide and a huge proud smile, presenting the palace behind him;
- a tourist couple stands on the right, one of them taking his picture with a phone, the other covering her mouth to keep from laughing.

THE MIDDLE OF THE TERRACE, from left to right:
- a stone wall with a low iron railing;
- a bench wet with fog, and a stone statue of a lion.

THE BACK, across the upper third of the picture:
- behind him, nothing but a thick white wall of fog: of the palace only the very tip of one yellow tower appears faintly at the top of the picture;
- dark green trees fading into the fog at the edges.

The terrace is quiet and white: between the people, the same bare stone paving and the same white fog.
